title: Tough,but fades.
text: Tough,but fades.. I've had this for a year now it did fade to a grey color.  I do like it other than fading. Very tough fabric. Has to handle rain snow, sun where I live. Has fabric handles on top to help pull it off.

product_metadata.title: LiBa Scalp Massager
description: We offer the highest quality premium grill cover with 600 denier thick fabric. Super hero features - love and protect your gas grill from hail, wind, heat, cold, bugs, insects, rain or snow. New or used. - Our grill covers won't rip and comes with a 36 month warranty if it does tear or rip. - Padded handles and Velcro straps to keep it secure on the grill. - Extremely easy to clean, you can hose it down with water and let it dry in the sun. Fits most brands - weber - Jenn air - brinkman - char-broil - measures 58x24x48 to cover most medium sized grills.
